description: Work out a part-time salary from the full-time salary and the hours or days worked compared with full time, with the take-home pay on the pro rata salary for a tax year.

actualUnits.description: Hours (or days) actually worked a week, in the same unit

fullTimeUnits.description: Full-time hours (or days) a week, e.g. 37.5

scottishTaxpayer.description: True for a Scottish taxpayer (Scottish bands)

studentLoanPlan.description: Student loan plan, if any (plan4 is Scotland, postgrad the postgraduate loan)

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.
